subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized Hindi/Urdu routing
body:
Model comparison results, a few days early.

On topline_dev (the held-out Dakshina set): training on mc4_train alone gets 88.9% accuracy, gen_train alone 85.4%, and the combination 91.2%. The mT5-generated strings clearly add coverage the seed-word-filtered mc4 data misses, even though alone they are weaker -- consistent with the paper's story.

Error analysis: the residual mistakes concentrate in short strings (under 5 tokens) where no seed word from full_list.tsv appears and the orthography is genuinely ambiguous. For those, Rafael suggests the honest answer is an 'ambiguous' third class rather than a forced binary call, and I agree -- the language-ID service can fall back to user locale on ambiguous.

Risk: adding the third class changes the service contract, so Katya needs a decision by end of March to hold the April integration date.

Nikhil
